title: Moonwell Editor settings
description: What Settings shows, and the theme, the code theme and the Warcraft III folder. Only what differs from the default needs to be here.

$schema.description: Where this schema is, for suggestions in the editor you write the file in.

appearance.theme.description: The editor theme, by id: the name of a theme file without .json, from the editor's own themes or the themes folder.

appearance.codeTheme.description: The theme scripts are drawn in, one of the VS Code themes. null is Dark Plus, or Light Plus when the editor theme is light.

appearance.uiScale.description: The size of the whole interface, in percent.

game.folder.description: The folder Warcraft III is installed in (the one with .build.info). null is the install the editor finds.

game.graphicsMode.description: Which graphics the icons and models are shown in: sd is Classic, hd is Reforged, de is Definitive Edition.

objects.teamColor.description: The team colour models are shown in, by the player colour's name.

objects.showHidden.description: List the objects World Editor does not show.

editor.confirm.description: Ask before reloading the map, deleting an object or dropping unsaved changes. When false, nothing is asked and unsaved changes are lost.

editor.alphaNotice.description: Show the alpha notice when the editor starts.

terminal.shell.description: The shell a new terminal runs, by its id (such as pwsh, bash or cmd). null is the first one found.
